questions.question: In John's vision, where did the mighty angel holding a small open scroll place his feet?

answers.text: One on the sea and one on the land
One on the mountain and one in the valley
One on the river and one on the shore

questions.question: In John's vision, the mighty angel swore by God the Creator of heaven, earth and sea. What did he announce?

answers.text: There will be no more delay

questions.question: In John's vision, an angel told him to eat a small scroll. What did the angel say it would do to his stomach?
After John ate the small scroll in his vision, what was he told he must do?

answers.text: Prophesy again about many peoples and kings
Wait in silence for the last trumpet
Keep the vision sealed for a while
